mapper.select:
SELECT emp35_deduct_id AS deduct_id, emp35_company_id AS company_id, emp35_person_id AS person_id, emp01_emp_no AS person_no, emp01_kor_nm AS person_name, emp01_hire_date AS hire_date, CAST(emp02_birthday AS date) AS birthday, emp35_basic_deduct_cnt AS basic_deduct_cnt, emp35_add_deduct_yn AS add_deduct_yn, emp35_insure_yn AS insure_yn, emp35_repr_yn AS repr_yn, CASE WHEN f_get_4insure_yn(emp35_person_id, #{stdDate}, '1') THEN 'false' ELSE 'true' END AS nps_yn, emp35_with_hold_rate AS with_hold_rate FROM (SELECT * , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY emp35_person_id ORDER BY emp35_start_date DESC) AS rn FROM emp35_deduct WHERE emp35_start_date <= #{stdDate} ) t INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = emp35_person_id INNER JOIN emp02_others ON emp02_person_id = emp35_person_id LEFT OUTER JOIN emp03_trans ON (emp03_person_id = emp35_person_id AND (emp03_person_id, emp03_trans_date) IN (SELECT emp03_person_id, MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = emp35_person_id AND emp03_trans_date <= #{stdDate} GROUP BY emp03_person_id)) WHERE rn = 1 AND emp35_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp03_trans_cd = (CASE #{transCode} WHEN '100' THEN (CASE WHEN emp03_trans_cd <= '799' THEN emp03_trans_cd ELSE #{transCode} END) WHEN '900' THEN '900' WHEN '800' THEN '800' ELSE emp03_trans_cd END)
AND emp35_person_id = #{personId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp35_deduct ( emp35_deduct_id, emp35_company_id, emp35_person_id, emp35_start_date , emp35_basic_deduct_cnt, emp35_add_deduct_yn, emp35_insure_yn, emp35_repr_yn , emp35_with_hold_rate, emp35_note, emp35_child_deduct_cnt ) VALUES ( #{deductId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{startDate} , #{basicDeductCnt}, #{addDeductYn}, #{insureYn}, #{reprYn} , #{withHoldRate}, #{note}, #{childDeductCnt} )

INSERT INTO emp36_add_deduct ( emp36_add_deduct_id, emp36_deduct_id, emp36_add_deduct_type, emp36_add_deduct_cnt ) WITH emp36 AS ( SELECT * FROM emp36_add_deduct WHERE emp36_deduct_id = ( SELECT emp35_deduct_id FROM emp35_deduct WHERE emp35_person_id = #{personId} AND emp35_start_date <= #{startDate} AND emp35_deduct_id != #{deductId} ORDER BY emp35_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) ) SELECT f_create_seq(), #{deductId}, emp36_add_deduct_type, emp36_add_deduct_cnt FROM emp36 UNION SELECT f_create_seq(), #{deductId}, sys09_code, 0 FROM ( SELECT sys09_code, sys09_name FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = #{itemTypeCodeName} EXCEPT SELECT emp36_add_deduct_type , f_cdnm('AddDeductType', emp36_add_deduct_type, NULL, f_today()) FROM emp36 ) t
mapper.select: SELECT emp36_add_deduct_id AS add_deduct_id, emp36_deduct_id AS deduct_id, emp36_add_deduct_type AS add_deduct_type, f_cdnm('AddDeductType', emp36_add_deduct_type, NULL, f_sysdate()) AS add_deduct_type_name, emp36_add_deduct_cnt AS add_deduct_cnt FROM emp36_add_deduct WHERE emp36_deduct_id = #{deductId} ORDER BY emp36_add_deduct_type
